entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: An abnormally mana-rich plane where magic flows freely, threatened by the growing hive mind of the slivers.

entities.name: The Onakke
entities.description: An ogre civilization once at home on Shandalar, adept at using its abundant mana to craft artifacts of terrible power.

entities.name: The slivers
entities.description: An ever-evolving race with a growing hive mind that threatens to consume Shandalar.

events.summary: The inhabitants of Shandalar must combat the growing hive mind of the slivers, which threatens to consume their world.
events.quote: Now the inhabitants of this unusual plane must combat the growing hive mind of the slivers
